say.en: A microphone gives only a few millivolts, but a loudspeaker needs volts. One transistor in common-emitter mode can make the signal a hundred times bigger. In this lesson: Draw a single-stage CE amplifier and state the role of each component.
Draw the DC and AC load lines.
Explain why the Q-point is kept at the middle of the load line.

body.en: In a practical *CE amplifier*, the voltage divider $R_1$, $R_2$ biases the base, $R_C$ is the collector load and $R_E$ stabilises the operating point. The input coupling capacitor $C_{in}$ passes the AC signal but blocks DC from the source. The output coupling capacitor $C_C$ passes the amplified signal to the load $R_L$ and blocks the collector DC. The emitter bypass capacitor $C_E$ short-circuits $R_E$ for AC, so the gain is not reduced. The output is 180° out of phase with the input.

points.en: RE: Q-*point* stability; CE: bypasses RE for AC
Cin, CC: pass AC, block DC
Output is 180° out of phase with input

narration.en: A CE amplifier needs bias resistors, a collector load, an emitter resistor with a bypass capacitor, and coupling capacitors at the input and output. The output is inverted.

say.en: Start with the transistor. The collector goes through RC to plus VCC; the emitter side goes to the common ground line.
R1 and R2 divide VCC to bias the base. RE stabilises the Q-point, and CE bypasses RE for the signal so the gain is not lost.
Cin brings in the signal but blocks the source DC. CC passes the amplified signal to the load RL and blocks the collector DC.
A small input gives a large output, turned upside down: the CE amplifier shifts the phase by 180 degrees.

title.en: DC load line, AC load line and Q-point

body.en: With no signal, $V_{CE} = V_{CC} - I_C(R_C + R_E)$. On the output characteristics this is the *DC load line*, joining the cut-off point $(V_{CC}, 0)$ to the saturation point $(0,\ V_{CC}/(R_C+R_E))$. For the signal, $C_E$ shorts $R_E$ and $C_C$ connects $R_L$, so the AC load is $r_L = R_C \parallel R_L$ and the AC load line through Q is steeper. The Q-point is placed near the middle of the load line so the output can swing equally both ways without clipping.

points.en: Q at the centre gives the largest undistorted swing

narration.en: The DC load line joins VCC on the voltage axis to VCC over RC plus RE on the current axis. Keep the Q-point in the middle for the biggest clean output.
narration.kn: ಡಿಸಿ ಲೋಡ್ ರೇಖೆ ವೋಲ್ಟೇಜ್ ಅಕ್ಷದ VCC ಯನ್ನು ಪ್ರವಾಹ ಅಕ್ಷದ VCC/(RC + RE) ಗೆ ಸೇರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. AC ಲೋಡ್ rL = RC ∥ RL. ವಿಕೃತಿ ಇಲ್ಲದ ಗರಿಷ್ಠ ಔಟ್‌ಪುಟ್‌ಗಾಗಿ ಕ್ಯೂ-ಬಿಂದುವನ್ನು ಲೋಡ್ ರೇಖೆಯ ಮಧ್ಯದಲ್ಲಿ ಇಡುತ್ತಾರೆ.

problem.en: In a CE amplifier VCC = 12 V, RC = 2 kΩ, RE = 1 kΩ and IC = 2 mA at the Q-point. Find VCE and the two end points of the DC load line.

steps.en: VCE = VCC − IC(RC + RE) = 12 − 2 mA × 3 kΩ = 12 − 6 = 6 V.
Cut-off point: IC = 0, VCE = VCC = 12 V.
Saturation point: VCE = 0, IC(sat) = 12 V / 3 kΩ = 4 mA.
Q (6 V, 2 mA) is exactly at the middle of the load line.

answer.en: VCE = 6 V; load line from (12 V, 0) to (0, 4 mA)

narration.en: Let us work this out together. In a CE amplifier VCC = 12 V, RC = 2 kΩ, RE = 1 kΩ and IC = 2 mA at the Q-point. Find VCE and the two end points of the DC load line.

say.en: Let us work this out together. In a CE amplifier VCC equals 12 volts, RC equals 2 k ohms, RE equals 1 k ohms and IC equals 2 milliamperes at the Q-point. Find VCE and the two end points of the DC load line.
VCE equals VCC - ICRC plus RE equals 12 minus 2 milliamperes times 3 k ohms equals 12 minus 6 equals 6 volts.
Cut-off point: IC equals 0, VCE equals VCC equals 12 volts.
Saturation point: VCE equals 0, ICsat equals 12 volts divided by 3 k ohms equals 4 milliamperes.
Q (6 volts, 2 milliamperes) is exactly at the middle of the load line.
So the answer is VCE equals 6 volts; load line from (12 volts, 0) to (0, 4 milliamperes).

steps.en: rL = 3.20 kΩ, less than RC, so the AC load line is steeper.

say.en: Let us work this out together. RC equals 4.7 k ohms and the load RL equals 10 k ohms. Find the AC load resistance.
rL equals RC RL over RC plus RL equals 4.7 times 10 over 14.7 k ohms.
rL equals 3.20 k ohms, less than RC, so the AC load line is steeper.
So the answer is rL is approximately 3.2 k ohms.

homework.en: Draw a neat circuit of a single-stage CE amplifier and write the function of each component.
VCC = 9 V, RC = 2 kΩ, RE = 1 kΩ: draw the DC load line and mark a centred Q-point.

narration.en: Recap. The CE amplifier uses divider bias, RC, RE with bypass CE, and coupling capacitors. DC load line: from (VCC, 0) to (0, VCC/(RC + RE)). AC load rL = RC ∥ RL; the AC load line is steeper. A centred Q-point gives the largest undistorted output.
narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ. ಸಿಇ ವರ್ಧಕದಲ್ಲಿ ವಿಭಜಕ ಬಯಾಸ್, RC, ಬೈಪಾಸ್ CE ಸಹಿತ RE ಮತ್ತು ಜೋಡಣಾ ಧಾರಕಗಳಿವೆ. ಡಿಸಿ ಲೋಡ್ ರೇಖೆ: (VCC, 0) ಇಂದ (0, VCC/(RC + RE)) ವರೆಗೆ. AC ಲೋಡ್ rL = RC ∥ RL; AC ಲೋಡ್ ರೇಖೆ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಕಡಿದಾಗಿದೆ. ಮಧ್ಯದ ಕ್ಯೂ-ಬಿಂದು ವಿಕೃತಿ ಇಲ್ಲದ ಗರಿಷ್ಠ ಔಟ್‌ಪುಟ್ ನೀಡುತ್ತದೆ.
